decisions.reason: Because this dumper was only briefly signaled in 2019, sits in a crowded and less differentiated segment, and the firm already showed with A and B that it quickly reallocates resources when a new line likely falls short of aspiration levels.

As a multi-model inclined furniture lift line with its own page, it shows more commitment and serviceability, so boundedly rational management would likely keep it while results remain uncertain but not clearly below aspiration.

This building material lift line fits the firm's construction and lifting capabilities best, so comparable-firm aspirations are more likely reachable and available service slack supports continuation.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift is more peripheral and integration-intensive, so if performance is only middling the firm would likely redeploy engineering and service resources to stronger core or development projects.
